page_limit = 20

    album_page = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)

        break
    page_index += 1
liked_songs = []

    if len(liked_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print({"album_count": len(album_library), "liked_song_count": len(liked_songs)})
